source: National Rail Enquiries, via the Rail Data Marketplace
messages: There are no train services at this station on Saturday 17 and Sunday 18 October because of engineering work. More details are available from the Disruptions area of the National Rail website .

Trains running between Edinburgh and Dunbar / Berwick-upon-Tweed may be cancelled, delayed by up to 80 minutes or revised. Latest information can be found on the Disruptions page of the National Rail website.
